assembly_digest_method: SHA-256 over ordered canonical lines '<path>:<git_blob_sha>\n' for the four overlay components in order, then the output contract
why_the_contract_is_inside_the_freeze: v0.3 froze only the three markdown components while the executors injected schemas/result.schema.json at runtime. The output contract is behavior-relevant, so a schema edit could change candidate behavior without changing the frozen digest. v0.4 binds the contract into the assembly and the executors read its path from this manifest.
qualification_scope: stability and construct-validity repair cycle; NOT library-admitted. No qualification claim until the preregistered repeated-trial gate passes.
freeze_rules: Do not edit any frozen component or the bound output contract during a scored cycle.
Graders may not be broadened to accept an observed output. Construct repairs require a recorded burn and a fresh case.
Fixtures authored by the party performing the repair are development/regression evidence, never held-out qualification evidence.
Any behavioral failure ends the cycle; repair requires a new candidate version and a new freeze.
